notes:
Account: large legal+compliance corp building internal knowledge search for litigation teams. Primary pain: scale (50M+ docs), tail-latency for short Q/A, and unpredictable cost per query on current hybrid setup. Currently using vector DB + in-house Lambda reranker. Interested in migrating embeddings + reranker to Redwood to get predictable latencies and rollouts.

POC summary: 2-week POC (index subset ~3M docs) ran 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-14. Embedding candidates tested: open-embedding-v3, redwood-embed-compact, and vendor-provided model. Reranker candidates: current in-house BERT pairwise reranker vs Redwood-ranked cross-encoder (quantized).

Key POC results (high level):
- Latency: baseline (in-house) 180ms median, 800ms 95th on QPS=50. Redwood dedicated config (4xA10) produced 65ms median, 210ms 95th on same QPS (no batching opt).
- Cost: baseline infra (managed + Lambdas) ~$0.22/query. Redwood dedicated estimate with batching/caching: $0.07-$0.10/query at projected QPS.
- Quality: initial embedding switch improved recall@100 by +3.8% but degraded NDCG@10 for reranker by -1.6% on legal test set (sample size 4,000 queries). Human eval: 30 human judgments flagged contextual precision regressions on complex citations.

Evals-driven migration plan: customer wants an evals-first rollout. Requirements captured: reproducible eval harness, per-prompt quality thresholds (NDCG@10 >= baseline -0.5 pts), live A/B with canary traffic 5% -> 25% -> 50% with automated rollback if human-eval failure rate >2%. They insist on automated regression alerts and integration with their QA tooling.

Security/compliance: SSO required, audit logs for token-level usage, ability to keep raw docs in their VPC and only surface embeddings to Redwood for serving is preferred. Legal team requires data residency in NA with strict retention controls.

Quotes / on-call notes:
- "We will not accept a reranker that reduces citation precision — that kills trust with lawyers." — Head of Search, 2026-02-18.
- AE note: customer very price-sensitive at scale; cost delta needs to be demonstrable in POC billing.

Open items / next steps:
- Configure canary A/B harness (Redwood + their eval harness).
- Run larger indexing POC on 30M doc shard (target mid-March).
- Legal to sign data-residency addendum (in progress).
- SE to produce cost-per-query projection for Dedicated vs Private for 200 QPS sustained.
